title: Haiti: independence and recognition
hook: Did winning independence bring immediate recognition?

predict.question: Did the US immediately recognize independent Haiti?

frames.heading: Rebellion
frames.text: Enslaved people rebel in northern Saint-Domingue.

frames.heading: Displacement
frames.text: Conflict sends refugees toward US ports.

frames.heading: US recognition
frames.text: The United States finally recognizes Haiti.

reveal: Winning independence and gaining recognition were different struggles. The revolt of enslaved people led to an independent Haiti in 1804, but US leaders withheld recognition until 1862. Refugees, trade and fears among slaveholders connected the revolution to places beyond the island.
limit: Selected political and refugee connections; no single arrow explains the revolution.
